description: Automatically look up customer in RIMS database using their phone number from caller ID. Returns customer details, certificate info, and deposit status.

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Customer phone number from caller ID

usage_instructions.when_to_call: IMMEDIATELY at the start of every call, before greeting the customer
usage_instructions.how_to_use: Set the phone parameter to {{call.from_number}} to automatically use caller ID
usage_instructions.silent_execution: Set speak_during_execution to false so customer doesn't hear the lookup
usage_instructions.branching_logic: After execution, check if customer_found is true or false to personalize greeting

customer_not_found.message: Customer not found in RIMS database
